name: Cohen et al. 2023
use_en: Ancient DNA from Negev Highlands desert grape pips, a Late Antiquity wine lineage.
use_zh: 内盖夫高地荒漠葡萄种子的古DNA，显示古代晚期的一个酿酒谱系。
note: Includes radiocarbon dating of pips. Ancient reads: ENA PRJNA887039 (Ancient Negev grape DNA, 20 runs). Modern panels cited in the literature review: PRJNA887737, PRJNA647155.

name: Inanli et al. 2026
use_en: Cetamura del Chianti wells: multiproxy aDNA, morphometrics and NIR. 80 seeds from two wells; over a quarter belong to one clone kept for centuries, likely white-berried; two pips were consistent with dark berries.
use_zh: 切塔穆拉井中的多项证据（古DNA、形态测量和近红外）。两口井中的 80 粒种子；超过四分之一属于一个延续数世纪的克隆，该主导无性系可能结白果；另有 2 粒符合深色果。
note: Data: ENA PRJEB89110 (title matches the paper; DS14). Wording follows the abstract: it does not say that most seeds were white-berry like.

name: Noraz et al. 2026
use_en: 49 archaeological pips spanning about 4000 years, mostly from France, plus Ibiza and nearby areas; clonal continuity includes a medieval match to Pinot Noir and a medieval Ibiza match to Folha de Figueira.
use_zh: 约 4000 年间的 49 粒考古种子，多数来自法国，也包括伊维萨岛及附近地区；无性系连续性包括一粒中世纪样本与黑皮诺一致，以及伊维萨岛一粒中世纪样本与 Folha de Figueira 一致。
note: Data: ENA PRJEB94459, titled ancient grapevine genomes from France and Ibiza (DS14). The paper focuses primarily on France; sample V156 is from medieval Ibiza (1027-1160 CE). Do not call the set '49 French pips'.

name: Pérez-Jordà et al. 2026
use_en: 28 seeds from Iberia and Sardinia; eastern introductions, local wild hybridisation, and long clonal persistence of Heben and Pasa Valenciana.
use_zh: 伊比利亚和撒丁岛的 28 粒种子；东方引入、与本地野生种杂交，以及赫本和帕萨巴伦西亚的长期无性保存。
note: ENA accession for this paper was not confirmed in the literature review. PRJEB104344 ('Shotgun sequencing of two Iberian grapevine cultivar founders') is a candidate only and is not recorded here as the paper's dataset [待确认] (accession). Do not treat that project ID as verified.

name: Ramos-Madrigal et al. 2019
use_en: 28 archaeological grape seeds (France), target-enriched around about 10,000 SNPs (10,207) selected from the 18K grape array (Laucou et al. 2018); one medieval seed matched living Savagnin Blanc.
use_zh: 28 粒考古葡萄种子（法国），针对从 18K 葡萄芯片中选出的约 1 万个 SNP（10,207；Laucou 等 2018）做靶向富集；一粒中世纪种子与现用萨瓦涅白一致。
note: Data: PRJNA489970 and figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.7610987 (DS14). The 10,207 SNP count is from Laucou et al. 2018 and from Cohen 2023 / Noraz 2026 descriptions of this design. Capture with myBaits is reported as myBaits protocol v3.0 in Cohen 2023's account of the same panel, not from the Ramos-Madrigal 2019 Methods (paywalled in the literature review) [待确认] (in the original Methods). The abstract says 28 archaeological grape seeds; the title and PRJNA489970 point to France, but the abstract does not itself say that every seed is French [待确认].

name: Archaeological grape seeds (pips)
use_en: Preferred tissue in published grape aDNA studies: waterlogged or desiccated seeds, sometimes with a split reserved for radiocarbon. Tissue origin of the recovered DNA (seed coat, embryo or endosperm) has not been directly verified.
use_zh: 已发表葡萄古DNA研究中最常用的材料：饱水或干燥的种子，有时可剖开一部分做碳十四。回收 DNA 的组织来源（种皮、胚还是胚乳）未经直接验证。
note: Charred seeds usually yield little DNA. Combine with morphometrics (Terral school) when possible. Published grape pip studies that describe sampling used whole-seed grinding or drilling (Cohen 2023; Bolognesi 2025). No published grape pip study reviewed here reported allele-ratio evidence for the contributing tissue. See section 1 of the README and decision point 1 in docs/WORKFLOW.md.

name: Wood, fruit residues and herbarium sheets
use_en: Secondary tissues: waterlogged wood, fruit remains, and historical herbarium leaves or pips, each with different inhibitor and damage profiles.
use_zh: 次要材料：饱水木材、果实残体，以及标本馆的叶片或种子，抑制剂和损伤情况各不相同。
note: Herbarium sheets often have a known collection year, which is a dating prior. Mercuric chloride treatments damage DNA.

name: Dedicated pre-PCR aDNA laboratory
ver_src: standard aDNA practice, summarised in Latorre et al. 2020
use_en: All extraction and library setup in a dedicated, physically separated pre-amplification space, with PPE, bleach or equivalent cleaning, and unidirectional workflow.
use_zh: 提取和建库都在独立的扩增前空间进行，配防护、漂白或等效清洁，以及单向工作流。
note: DOI is Latorre et al. 2020, which states these requirements for plant aDNA.

name: Extraction and library blanks
use_en: Run extraction blanks and library blanks in every batch and sequence them. A grape-wine laboratory is a high-risk modern-DNA environment.
use_zh: 每批都做提取空白和文库空白并测序。葡萄酒实验室是现代葡萄 DNA 的高风险环境。
note: Modern cultivar DNA in a viticulture institute can look like a true ancient match. Treat unexpected clone matches with extra contamination checks.

name: S-PDE extraction on archaeological grape pips (Bolognesi et al. 2025)
use_en: Soil-optimised extraction plus aDNA silica binding on ancient grape pips; higher library-success rate than CTAB or DNeasy in two archaeological contexts.
use_zh: 针对土壤抑制剂优化的提取，再加古DNA硅胶结合，用于古代葡萄种子；在两个考古背景中建库成功率高于 CTAB 或 DNeasy。
note: The paper supports a higher library-success rate for S-PDE than for CTAB or DNeasy in two archaeological contexts, with sample-size limits: the library comparison used n = 8 for CTAB and DNeasy and n = 30 for S-PDE (Fig. 2 legend). The fourth method, phenol-chloroform, yielded no detectable DNA in any of eight extracts in their hands, so it was not a direct comparison with earlier phenol-chloroform grape-pip protocols that had worked elsewhere.

name: Dabney silica binding for ultra-short DNA
use_en: Silica binding buffer that retains very short fragments, widely reused for plant remains.
use_zh: 能保住极短片段的硅胶结合缓冲液，被广泛用于植物遗存。
note: The paper is a cave bear mitogenome demonstration; the binding buffer is the widely used method.

name: PTB-DTT plant extraction (Gutaker / Latorre)
use_en: PTB and DTT release DNA from cross-links, then silica binding. Latorre et al. 2020 recommend it for old herbarium and archaeological remains.
use_zh: PTB 和 DTT 把交联中的 DNA 释放出来，再结合硅胶。Latorre 等 2020 建议用于较老的标本和考古遗存。
note: Gutaker et al. 2017 doi:10.2144/000114517. Protocol compilation: Latorre et al. 2020 doi:10.1002/cppb.20121. Marinček et al. 2022 (doi:10.1002/aps3.11477) found PTB-DTT better than a standard kit for old herbarium, while a kit may suffice for young sheets.

name: Wales and Kistler plant-remains extraction
use_en: Methods in Molecular Biology chapter on extracting ancient DNA from plant remains, including SDS versus CTAB choices.
use_zh: 《Methods in Molecular Biology》中关于从植物遗存提取古DNA的章节，包括 SDS 与 CTAB 的选择。
note: Earlier Kistler 2012 chapter: doi:10.1007/978-1-61779-516-9_10. A separate catalogue row covers Wales et al. 2014 (doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0086827), which reported SDS often outperforming CTAB on non-charred (mainly desiccated) archaeobotanical remains; no charred remains were tested.

name: Partial UDG (UDG-half) treatment
use_en: Removes most internal uracils but leaves terminal damage for authentication.
use_zh: 去掉大部分内部尿嘧啶，但保留末端损伤以便鉴定。
note: Choose UDG-half, full UDG, or no UDG in advance. No-UDG keeps more damage for authentication but complicates transition sites. Full UDG is cleaner for genotyping but weaker for damage evidence.

name: Meyer and Kircher double-stranded library
use_en: Classic blunt-end double-stranded aDNA library with single or dual indexing.
use_zh: 经典的平末端双链古DNA文库，可用单端或双端标签。
note: Pair with unique dual indexes (Kircher et al. 2012, doi:10.1093/nar/gkr771). The existing repo notes describe a dsDNA batch.

name: Gansauge single-stranded library (ssDNA2 and later automated versions)
use_en: Single-stranded libraries recover molecules with single-strand breaks or blocked ends, often better when endogenous content is low.
use_zh: 单链文库能回收带单链断裂或末端阻断的分子，内源含量低时往往更好。
note: 2013 Nature Protocols doi:10.1038/nprot.2013.038; 2017 NAR doi:10.1093/nar/gkx033; 2020 Nat Protoc doi:10.1038/s41596-020-0338-0.

name: Santa Cruz reaction (SCR)
use_en: Faster single-stranded library method used widely in aDNA labs; a 2025 protocols.io update also exists.
use_zh: 更快的单链建库方法，古DNA实验室常用；另有 2025 年 protocols.io 更新。
note: Kapp et al. 2021. Protocol updates on protocols.io were seen in search results but not used as a substitute for the paper.

name: In-solution target enrichment (myBaits / similar)
ver_src: used in Ramos-Madrigal 2019 and later grape studies; kit version not pinned here
use_en: In-solution capture around a grape SNP panel. Ramos-Madrigal et al. and later grape papers used about 10,000 SNPs (10,207) selected from the 18K grape array (Laucou et al. 2018).
use_zh: 针对葡萄 SNP 面板的溶液内捕获。Ramos-Madrigal 及后续葡萄论文用的是从 18K 芯片中选出的约 1 万个 SNP（10,207；Laucou 等 2018）。
note: Do not call the capture panel an 18k-site panel. The 10,207 figure is from Laucou et al. 2018 (10.1371/journal.pone.0192540). Cohen 2023 reports capturing this set with the myBaits protocol version 3.0; that kit version is Cohen's description [待确认] (against Ramos-Madrigal 2019 Methods). Kit version in general remains [待确认].

name: Shallow shotgun screening then deeper shotgun
use_en: Screen libraries shallowly, then sequence deeper only those with usable endogenous content and authentic damage.
use_zh: 先浅测筛选文库，再只对内源含量可用、损伤真实的文库加深测序。
note: Good when fragments are very short or bait design would miss variation.

name: Plastid, mitochondrion and rDNA as authentication and species ID
use_en: Organelle and rDNA reads can support authentication and genus-level identification. Vitis plastids are essentially maternally inherited, but sequence differences among Vitis species are small and chloroplast capture can occur, so plastid data are not enough for within-genus species or cultivar identification. Heteroplasmy-like patterns often come from nuclear plastid or mitochondrial insertions (NUPT, NUMT) and from plastid-derived tracts in the mitochondrial genome.
use_zh: 细胞器和核糖体 DNA 读段可用于鉴定和属一级的物种判断。葡萄质体基本上是母系遗传，但葡萄属各物种之间序列差异很小，还可能发生叶绿体捕获，所以质体数据不足以做属内种或品种鉴定。类似异质性的信号，往往来自核基因组里的质体或线粒体插入（NUPT、NUMT），以及线粒体基因组里的质体来源片段。
note: Use organelle-to-nuclear read ratios only as a secondary preservation or authenticity indicator, and compete-map to reduce NUPT/NUMT confusion. See also grapevine-plastid.

name: Unique dual indexing and short-insert PE sequencing
ver: Kircher et al. 2012 plus current Illumina practice
ver_src: Kircher DOI verified; instrument versions not pinned
use_en: Use unique dual indexes to limit index hopping. Paired-end 75 or 100 bp usually covers typical aDNA insert lengths.
use_zh: 使用唯一双端标签以减少 index hopping。双端 75 或 100 bp 通常覆盖典型古DNA插入长度。
note: Demultiplex conservatively. Do not invent a preferred instrument model; record the one actually used.

name: AdapterRemoval
use_en: Trims adapters, collapses overlapping pairs, and applies a minimum length. Default in the existing repo notes.
use_zh: 修剪接头、合并重叠双端，并设最小长度。本仓库现有笔记中的默认工具。
note: The verified DOI is AdapterRemoval v2 (Schubert 2016). Newest software is 3.0.2. Existing notes use --trimqualities --minquality 2 --trimns --minlength 25 --collapse (dsDNA batch --minlength 30). Re-check flags if you move from v2 to v3. The catalogue version is the newest tool line (v2 paper already cited). The first AdapterRemoval paper is Lindgreen 2012, 10.1186/1756-0500-5-337, and is not a second tool entry.

name: Cutadapt
ver_src: Bioconda/PyPI cutadapt 5.2; GitHub tags are stale (v4.0)
use_en: General adapter trimmer; usable, but aDNA pipelines more often use AdapterRemoval or leeHom because of collapsing.
use_zh: 通用接头修剪器；可用，但古DNA流程更常用 AdapterRemoval 或 leeHom，因为需要合并双端。

name: leeHom
use_en: Bayesian adapter trimming and merging, an alternative used in some aDNA pipelines.
use_zh: 贝叶斯接头修剪与合并，部分古DNA流程中的备选。
note: Method paper: 10.1093/nar/gku699 (Crossref-verified in the literature review).

name: preseq
use_en: Library-complexity curves, used in nf-core/eager to decide whether deeper sequencing is worthwhile.
use_zh: 文库复杂度曲线，nf-core/eager 用它判断是否值得加深测序。

name: FastQ Screen
use_en: Screens reads against grape, human, microbes and other plants to catch swaps and contamination.
use_zh: 把读段放到葡萄、人类、微生物和其他植物参考上筛查，以便发现拿错和污染。
note: Competitive mapping against several Vitis references or a graph is the natural next step (project 20).

name: Kraken2
ver_src: Bioconda kraken2 2.17.2 (latest stable); GitHub also has v2.18.0-RC2, not used here
use_en: Taxonomic composition of unmapped or all reads.
use_zh: 对未比对或全部读段做分类组成分析。
note: A 2.18.0 release candidate exists (2026-11-06) and is not used as the catalog version.

name: MALT
use_en: Alignment-based metagenomic binning, used inside nf-core/eager.
use_zh: 基于比对的宏基因组分箱，用于 nf-core/eager。

name: vg Giraffe
use_en: Map ancient reads to a Vitis pangenome graph and compare allele balance with linear mapping (project 20).
use_zh: 把古代读段比对到葡萄泛基因组图上，并与线性比对的等位基因平衡做比较（项目 20）。
note: Test on downsampled modern grapes before ancient seeds.

name: samtools + Picard MarkDuplicates or DeDup
use_en: Post-mapping BAM filters. For collapsed single-end aDNA reads, DeDup is the default duplicate marker because it uses both endpoints; Picard MarkDuplicates uses only the 5-prime coordinate and can over-remove. Keep MarkDuplicates as a comparison.
use_zh: 比对后的 BAM 过滤。对合并后的单端古DNA读段，默认用 DeDup 去重复，因为它同时使用两端坐标；Picard MarkDuplicates 只看 5 端坐标，会多删。MarkDuplicates 可作对照。
note: Default for collapsed reads: DeDup. Quote the reason when the other tool is used. samtools 1.25; Picard 3.5.0; DeDup 0.12.9 (versions from the v1 check).

name: CircularMapper
use_en: Improves mapping to circular organelle references (plastid, mitochondrion).
use_zh: 改善对环状细胞器参考（质体、线粒体）的比对。
note: Complementary to nuclear bwa aln, not a replacement.

name: bowtie2
use_en: Alternative local aligner offered by nf-core/eager.
use_zh: nf-core/eager 提供的备选局部比对器。
note: Use only if a comparison against bwa aln is pre-registered. Not the default in the existing repo scripts.

name: bwa aln (disabled seeding)
ver_src: GitHub lh3/bwa + Bioconda, 2026-11-14 CST; parameter sources listed in the note
use_en: Default short-read aligner for damaged aDNA. Write each parameter and its source separately; do not mix script values with literature values.
use_zh: 损伤古DNA短读的默认比对器。各参数和出处要分开写，不要把仓库脚本里的值和文献参数混在一起。
note: Parameter sources, checked against Schubert et al. 2012 (10.1186/1471-2164-13-178): `-l 1024` disables the seed on Illumina data (Schubert 2012); Schubert kept the default `-n` 0.04 for Illumina. The Helicos setting in that paper is `-l 1024 -i 0 -o 2 -n 0.03`, not the Illumina setting. The combination `-n 0.01 -o 2` is common in ancient human studies (often with `-l 16500`) and is cited by Dolenz et al. 2024 as coming from Green et al. 2010; the original source remains [待确认]. For a benchmark of parameterised BWA-aln, BWA-mem and NovoAlign on simulated human reads, see the Oliva et al. 2021 row; that paper does not establish a single preferred aligner.

name: DamageProfiler
use_en: Faster damage-pattern calculation, the nf-core/eager alternative to mapDamage2.
use_zh: 更快的损伤模式计算，nf-core/eager 中相对 mapDamage2 的备选。
note: Last tagged release remains 1.1 (2020). Still the current Bioconda version.

name: mapDamage2
use_en: Default damage and fragmentation profile in AM17 and in scripts/run_mapdamage.sh.
use_zh: AM17 和 scripts/run_mapdamage.sh 中的默认损伤与片段长度分析。
note: Existing wrapper: mapDamage -i BAM -r REF -d OUT --merge-reference-sequences. Use this, not a later untested flag set, unless you re-validate. Cite with the original mapDamage paper (Ginolhac et al. 2011, 10.1093/bioinformatics/btr347) when describing damage plots. --rescale can downweight likely damaged bases as an alternative to hard trimming; compare the two on downsampled data.

name: PMDtools
use_en: Scores and filters reads by post-mortem damage, separating endogenous from modern-like reads.
use_zh: 按死后损伤给读段打分并过滤，把内源读段和更像现代的读段分开。
note: Skoglund et al. 2014 DOI verified.

name: pyDamage
use_en: Per-contig damage estimation, useful when many references are involved (metagenomes or competitive mapping).
use_zh: 按条目估计损伤，适合参考很多的情况（宏基因组或竞争性比对）。

name: AuthentiCT
ver_src: GitHub StephanePeyregne/AuthentiCT tag and release v1.0.1 (2023-03-10), checked 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Estimates present-day contamination from damage patterns. Applies to any species with a reference, but only to single-stranded libraries.
use_zh: 用损伤模式估计现代污染。只要有参考基因组就可用于各物种，但仅限单链文库。
note: Single-stranded libraries only. Do not use it on UDG-treated data or after PMD filtering (official README). The repository exists (https://github.com/StephanePeyregne/AuthentiCT); it is not a 404. Do not run it on the default double-stranded branch of this workflow.

name: hapCon
ver_src: Huang et al. 2022 paper verified; software tag not checked
use_en: Human contamination estimator that uses the male X chromosome. Listed only to prevent misuse; it does not apply to grape.
use_zh: 利用男性 X 染色体估计人类污染的工具。列在这里只是为了防止误用，不适用于葡萄。
note: hapCon requires a hemizygous male X chromosome (Huang and Ringbauer 2022). Grape has no such chromosome, so this is not a tool that can be tested into applicability. Keep the entry as a warning, like schmutzi.

name: schmutzi
use_en: Mitochondrial contamination estimator written for humans. Not a grape nuclear contamination tool.
use_zh: 为人类设计的线粒体污染估计。不是葡萄核基因组污染工具。
note: Listed so that it is not used by mistake for nuclear grape data. Written for human mtDNA; grape use would need testing. Listed to prevent uncritical reuse. DOI 10.1186/s13059-015-0776-0.

name: Blanks, species composition and excess heterozygosity
ver_src: methods practice; no single software DOI
use_en: Plant-appropriate contamination checks: sequenced blanks, competitive mapping and species composition, and excess heterozygosity. A mixture of maternal and embryo DNA can also shift allele ratios away from 0.5 and can be misread as contamination.
use_zh: 适合植物的污染检查：测序空白对照、竞争性比对和物种组成，以及杂合度过高。母本组织与胚的混合也会使等位比例偏离 0.5，可能被误当成污染。
note: Treat a maternal-plus-embryo tissue mixture and present-day DNA contamination as competing explanations when allele ratios or heterozygosity look unusual. Allele ratios alone cannot separate the two. See the pre-registered two-genotype mixture test in section 13.

name: GLIMPSE2
ver_src: GitHub odelaneau/GLIMPSE tag v2.0.0 (latest stable), 2026-11-14 CST; v2.0.1 is a GitHub pre-release and is not used as the catalogue version
use_en: Impute ancient grape genomes only after measuring accuracy on modern samples downsampled to the same depth (AM17, project 20).
use_zh: 只有在把现代样本降到相同深度并测过准确性之后，才对古代葡萄基因组做补全（AM17，项目 20）。
inp: low-coverage BAM or GLs, modern haplotype panel
note: For aDNA, test accuracy on modern grapes downsampled to ancient depths first (AM17, project 20). GitHub v2.0.1 is marked pre-release (checked 2026-11-14 CST); Bioconda glimpse-bio may still list 2.0.1. This catalogue pins the latest stable tag, 2.0.0, consistent with not using RC or beta tags as the catalogue version.

name: ANGSD haploid calls and genotype likelihoods
use_en: Preferred likelihood route: do not force diploid GT at very low coverage. Random haploid draws or genotype likelihoods for structure.
use_zh: 更推荐的似然路径：在极低覆盖度下不要强行做二倍体基因型。结构分析可用随机单倍型抽取或基因型似然。
note: For no-UDG data, consider transversion-only analyses. Grapevine heterozygosity makes naive majority-call genotypes noisy.

name: ATLAS
ver_src: Bioconda atlas 2.0.4; expected Wegmann-lab source not resolved on GitHub in this check
use_en: Damage-aware aDNA caller. Bioconda version 2.0.4 was seen; confirm the bitbucket source before pinning.
use_zh: 考虑损伤的古DNA检测器。见到了 Bioconda 的 2.0.4；钉版本前请确认 bitbucket 来源。
note: URL and exact upstream tag [待确认].

name: sequenceTools pileupCaller
use_en: Pseudo-haploid calls from pileup, widely used to place aDNA on modern SNP panels.
use_zh: 从 pileup 做伪单倍型调用，常用来把古DNA放到现代 SNP 面板上。
note: For single-stranded libraries use `--singleStrandMode` (available since v1.4.0). For no-UDG data, drop transition sites or otherwise account for damage. Keep the SNP set matched to the modern panel. Version v1.6.0.0 matches the GitHub release (2026-01-28).

name: BEAST 2
use_en: Tip-dating of ancient grape sequences. Restrict to transversions or UDG-treated data, and randomise tips as a test.
use_zh: 古代葡萄序列的末端定年。应限制在颠换或 UDG 处理过的数据，并用末端随机化做检验。
note: Herbarium sheets with a collection year are safer tips than poorly dated seeds. Tip dates equal the seed's death date; the clonal genotype may already have existed for centuries. Molecular tip-dating has essentially no information when an ancient pip is the same clone as a living cultivar; use it only for samples separated by sexual generations. Prefer transversions or UDG-treated data.

name: LSD2
use_en: Least-squares dating of trees with dated tips.
use_zh: 对带日期末端的树做最小二乘定年。
note: Tip dates equal the seed's death date; the clonal genotype may already have existed for centuries. Molecular tip-dating has essentially no information when an ancient pip is the same clone as a living cultivar; use it only for samples separated by sexual generations. Prefer transversions or UDG-treated data.

name: TreeTime
use_en: Fast time-tree placement, mainly a sanity check rather than a grape domestication clock.
use_zh: 快速时间树放置，主要作为合理性检查，而不是葡萄驯化时钟。
note: Tip dates equal the seed's death date; the clonal genotype may already have existed for centuries. Molecular tip-dating has essentially no information when an ancient pip is the same clone as a living cultivar; use it only for samples separated by sexual generations. Prefer transversions or UDG-treated data.

name: AMS radiocarbon on the same seed or a paired seed
ver_src: used in Cohen et al. 2023 and Inanli et al. 2026 among others
use_en: Date the same biological individual when tissue allows, or a tightly associated seed from the same context.
use_zh: 材料允许时对同一个体测年，否则对同一背景中密切关联的种子测年。
note: Cohen et al. 2023 is one grape example that combined aDNA and radiocarbon. Calibration curve choice (IntCal) belongs in the lab report.

name: Bchron
use_en: Bayesian radiocarbon calibration and chronology in R.
use_zh: 在 R 中做贝叶斯碳十四校正和年代学。

name: rcarbon
use_en: Calibration, SPD and demographic-sum tools for radiocarbon dates.
use_zh: 碳十四校正、SPD 和年代汇总工具。
note: OxCal is widely used but is a vendor application; version was not checked in this build [待确认].

name: Identity to living cultivars
ver_src: results reported in Ramos-Madrigal 2019, Noraz 2026, Pérez-Jordà 2026
use_en: Test whether an ancient pip is the same clone as a living cultivar, a first-degree relative of one, or only from the same broader group. These outcomes depend on an unverified tissue-origin assumption and on contamination controls.
use_zh: 检验一粒古籽与现存品种是同一克隆、一级亲缘，还是仅仅来自同一更大的群体。这些结论依赖于未经直接验证的组织来源假设，也依赖于污染控制。
out: kinship or IBS, with contamination checks
note: Same-clone language is only straightforward if the DNA mainly represents maternal seed-coat tissue. If it mainly represents the embryo, a parent-offspring relationship is the expected match to the mother cultivar. Distinguish same-clone from first-degree results in the write-up. Use low-coverage kinship tools (READv2, KIN, BREADR; calibrate on modern pairs downsampled to the same depth), not a generic 'kinship or IBS' cutoff and not KING hard-call thresholds. Molecular tip-dating is uninformative if the pip is the same clone as a living cultivar.

name: ADMIXTOOLS 2 f-statistics and qpAdm
use_en: f3, f4 and qpAdm with ancient and modern groups, after a pre-registered grouping.
use_zh: 在预先登记分组后，用古代和现代群体做 f3、f4 和 qpAdm。
note: Overlap with vitis-popgen is intentional.

name: hapROH on ancient cultivars
use_en: ROH from low-coverage data using a haplotype reference panel. Designed and tested on human data (1240k / 1000 Genomes panels). Not a clonal-history method: clonal propagation does not create ROH.
use_zh: 借助单倍型参考面板，从低覆盖度数据检测 ROH。按人类数据（1240k / 千人基因组面板）开发和测试。不能用来推断无性系历史：克隆繁殖不产生 ROH。
note: Human-specific as distributed. Use on Vitis only after building a Vitis phased haplotype panel and validating on modern grapes downsampled to the target depth; unvalidated results must not be reported. ROH reflects inbreeding at the sexual origin of the sampled genotype, not centuries of clonal propagation. Prefer species-general ROHan, or bcftools roh when depth is sufficient. Newest is 0.70 on GitHub/PyPI; Bioconda lagged at 0.64.

name: smartpca lsqproject
use_en: Project ancient samples onto a modern, clone-pruned grape PCA without letting them define the axes.
use_zh: 把古代样本投射到去克隆后的现代葡萄 PCA 上，而不让它们决定坐标轴。
note: Missingness and damage can still shift projections; report coverage and transition/transversion choices.

name: EAGER (legacy Java pipeline)
ver: see Peltzer 2016; superseded by nf-core/eager for new work
use_en: Original EAGER pipeline. Keep only to understand older papers; use nf-core/eager for new runs.
use_zh: 最初的 EAGER 流程。只用来理解旧论文；新分析请用 nf-core/eager。

name: PALEOMIX
use_en: Alternative pipeline for aDNA mapping, filtering and phylogenetic downstream steps.
use_zh: 古DNA比对、过滤和下游系统发育步骤的备选流程。
note: Schubert et al. 2014 Nature Protocols DOI verified.

name: nf-core/eager
ver_src: GitHub nf-core/eager 2.5.3 (2025-03-18); 3.0 Augsburg is not released (open milestone, 2026-11-14 CST)
use_en: Default end-to-end aDNA workflow in AM17: AdapterRemoval, bwa aln, DamageProfiler or mapDamage, DeDup or MarkDuplicates, Qualimap, preseq, optional PMDtools, Kraken2/MALT.
use_zh: AM17 中的默认端到端古DNA流程：AdapterRemoval、bwa aln、DamageProfiler 或 mapDamage、DeDup 或 MarkDuplicates、Qualimap、preseq，可选 PMDtools、Kraken2/MALT。
note: This is DSL1 and requires Nextflow >=20.07.1 and <=22.10.6. Version 3.0 is not released. Human contamination modules (ANGSD X-chromosome) must be turned off or ignored for grape.

name: Existing capture scripts and notes
use_en: Already in this repository: AdapterRemoval, bwa aln, samtools q30, Picard MarkDuplicates, Qualimap, mapDamage, and mapping-stat collection.
use_zh: 本仓库已有：AdapterRemoval、bwa aln、samtools q30、Picard MarkDuplicates、Qualimap、mapDamage，以及比对统计汇总。
inp: paired FASTQ, VS1.final.fa (path is a placeholder in the notes)
note: Files: scripts/adna_capture_pipeline_generator.sh, dsdna_preprocess.sh, collect_mapping_stats.sh, run_mapdamage.sh; notes/cap_test.md, check_pcrbias.md, mergeBAM.md. These files are existing material in the repository: a bioinformatics workflow for a capture test.

name: Grape-specific analytical issues
ver_src: synthesis of DS14, project 20, and this audit
use_en: Plant and grape caveats: inhibitors and polyphenols; no mammalian X-chromosome dose method for contamination; a small sex-determining region on chromosome 2 rather than heteromorphic sex chromosomes; most cultivars are hermaphroditic; plastid data are maternal but have low resolution within Vitis and can be misread because of NUPT/NUMT insertions; PN40024 reference bias; clone identity across centuries.
use_zh: 植物和葡萄的注意点：抑制剂和多酚；没有哺乳动物那种用 X 染色体剂量估计污染的办法；性别决定区是 2 号染色体上的一小段，不是异形性染色体；栽培品种大多是两性花；质体数据是母系的，但在葡萄属内分辨率低，还可能被核基因组中的质体/线粒体插入（NUPT、NUMT）干扰；PN40024 参考偏差；跨世纪的无性系身份。
note: Human X-chromosome contamination modules, including hapCon, do not transfer. See also grapevine-plastid for plastid assembly, and vitis-open-directions item 22 for sex-determining-region genotypes.

name: Latorre et al. 2020 plant aDNA protocols
use_en: End-to-end plant aDNA isolation, library preparation and bioinformatics protocol.
use_zh: 植物古DNA提取、建库和生物信息分析的端到端方案。

name: Ramos-Madrigal et al. 2026 plant palaeogenomics review
ver_src: Crossref title match; journal year 2026, DOI has 2025 suffix
use_en: Short review of plant palaeogenomics: the shift to genome-wide data, changing views of domestication, plant-microbe coevolution, sedimentary DNA, and lost diversity for crop improvement.
use_zh: 植物古基因组学短综述：转向全基因组数据、驯化观念的变化、植物与微生物共演化、沉积物 DNA，以及失去的遗传多样性在作物改良中的用途。
note: Wording follows the abstract (EuropePMC PMID 41610813). The abstract does not mention polyphenols, PCR inhibitors, single-stranded libraries, authentication, or grape tannins. Those topics should be cited from the Gansauge ss-library series and from Bolognesi 2025 / Wales 2014, not from this review, unless someone has read the full text [待确认].

name: DS14 archaeological grape seed sequencing
ver_src: DS14 README, sizes from ENA on 2026-11-14
use_en: PRJNA489970 (French capture), PRJEB89110 (Cetamura), PRJEB94459 (France 4000 years), PRJNA999173 (Grotte di Pertosa, linked paper [待确认]).
use_zh: PRJNA489970（法国捕获）、PRJEB89110（切塔穆拉）、PRJEB94459（法国 4000 年）、PRJNA999173（佩尔托萨洞，关联论文 [待确认]）。
note: No unpublished genotypes. figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.7610987 licence [待确认].

name: gargammel
use_en: Simulates aDNA reads with damage, fragment length and contamination, for pipeline tests.
use_zh: 模拟带损伤、片段长度和污染的古DNA读段，用于测试流程。
note: Use before trusting project-20 imputation thresholds.

name: ngsngs
use_en: Flexible NGS read simulator that can include aDNA-like features.
use_zh: 灵活的 NGS 读段模拟器，也可加入类似古DNA的特征。
note: Confirm aDNA parameters against the manual before using numbers in a preregistration.

name: samtools
use_en: Sort, index, mark duplicates, filter and report alignment statistics.
use_zh: 排序、建索引、标记重复、过滤并汇报比对统计。
note: Same 1.25 line as bcftools and htslib. samtools is not a mapper; it belongs with BAM processing, not under Mapping.

cluster: Phasing and imputation of modern data (in order)
name: GLIMPSE2
ver_src: GitHub odelaneau/GLIMPSE tag v2.0.0 (latest stable), 2026-11-14 CST; v2.0.1 is a GitHub pre-release and is not used as the catalogue version
use_en: Imputes low-coverage genomes from a haplotype reference panel.
use_zh: 用单倍型参考面板补全低覆盖度基因组。
inp: low-coverage BAM or genotype likelihoods, reference panel
note: For aDNA, test accuracy on modern grapes downsampled to ancient depths first (AM17, project 20). GitHub v2.0.1 is marked pre-release (checked 2026-11-14 CST); Bioconda glimpse-bio may still list 2.0.1. This catalogue pins the latest stable tag, 2.0.0, consistent with not using RC or beta tags as the catalogue version.

name: fastp
use_en: Trims adapters and low-quality bases and writes a QC report.
use_zh: 修剪接头和低质量碱基，并写出质控报告。
note: GitHub release 2026-10-07. Also in vitis-open-directions AM02.

name: KING
use_en: Robust kinship for clones or duplicates versus first-degree relatives. Clones and duplicates (kinship above 0.354) are reduced to one sample per group; first-degree relatives (0.177-0.354) are registered, not dropped as the same genotype. Not the default for low-coverage ancient pips.
use_zh: 用于区分克隆/重复与一级亲缘的稳健亲缘估计。克隆和重复（亲缘系数高于 0.354）每组只留一个样本；一级亲缘（0.177-0.354）只登记，不当作同一基因型删掉。 不是低覆盖古籽的默认方法。
note: Thresholds follow the KING manual (https://www.kingrelatedness.com/manual.shtml): kinship above 0.354 is the duplicate/MZ class; 0.177-0.354 is first-degree. Paper: Manichaikul et al. 2010, 10.1093/bioinformatics/btq559. AM26 used 0.177 as the first-degree lower cutoff. Input should be hard-called diploid genotypes (BED). For low-coverage or ancient samples use ngsRelate, READv2, KIN or BREADR instead. Handling of first-degree relatives is analysis-specific; see docs/WORKFLOW.md.

name: Picard
use_en: MarkDuplicates, read groups, CleanSam and related BAM hygiene.
use_zh: MarkDuplicates、读组、CleanSam 等 BAM 整理。
note: Picard works on BAM (MarkDuplicates, read groups, CleanSam), not on VCF. GitHub release 2026-07-31 CST-relative: 2026-08-01 02:56 CST. For collapsed aDNA reads, DeDup is the default duplicate marker; see section 8.

name: bcftools
use_en: Filter, normalise, annotate, compute statistics, and call ROH (see section 8).
use_zh: 过滤、规范化、注释、统计，以及 ROH 检测（见第 8 节）。

name: ADMIXTURE
use_en: Maximum-likelihood ancestry proportions; default in AM13.
use_zh: 最大似然祖源比例，AM13 的默认工具。
note: Clone-prune first (one sample per clone or duplicate group). First-degree relatives should not be dropped as if they were the same genotype; for ADMIXTURE use an unrelated subset or report a sensitivity analysis (see docs/WORKFLOW.md). Choose K with cross-validation and inspect fit with evalAdmix.

name: ANGSD
use_en: Genotype likelihoods, allele frequencies, SFS, association and haploid calls from BAM.
use_zh: 从 BAM 计算基因型似然、等位基因频率、SFS、关联和单倍型调用。
out: genotype likelihoods, SFS, MAF, haploid calls
note: Central for aDNA and low-coverage modern data. Human X-chromosome contamination utilities do not transfer to grape.

name: PCAngsd
use_en: PCA and admixture-style structure from genotype likelihoods, including low coverage.
use_zh: 用基因型似然做 PCA 和类混合结构分析，适用于低覆盖度。
note: Newest GitHub tag is 1.37.0; Bioconda lagged at 1.36.4.

name: smartpca (EIGENSOFT)
ver_src: Bioconda eigensoft 9.0.0; DReichLab/EIG GitHub tag v8.0.0
use_en: PCA with shrinkage and lsqproject, the usual way to project aDNA onto a modern PCA.
use_zh: 带收缩和 lsqproject 的 PCA，通常用来把古DNA投射到现代 PCA 上。
note: Pin the exact binary. Bioconda and GitHub numbers disagree.

name: BEAST 2
use_en: Bayesian trees and tip-dating when time calibrations exist.
use_zh: 有时间校准时可做贝叶斯树和末端定年。
note: For aDNA tip-dating use transversions or UDG-treated data. Tip dates equal the seed's death date; the clonal genotype may already have existed for centuries. Molecular tip-dating has essentially no information when an ancient pip is the same clone as a living cultivar; use it only for samples separated by sexual generations. Prefer transversions or UDG-treated data.

name: tsinfer
use_en: Infers a tree sequence (ARG approximation) from phased large samples.
use_zh: 从已定相的大样本推断树序列（ARG 的近似）。
note: Pair with tsdate. Clone-prune and deal with close kinship first (AM14, project 10).

name: SMC++
use_en: Effective-size history from many unphased genomes.
use_zh: 从许多未定相基因组推断有效种群大小历史。
note: Reduce clones and duplicates to one sample per group. For recent Ne, also remove or model first-degree relatives (see docs/WORKFLOW.md).

name: ADMIXTOOLS 2
use_en: f2, f3, f4, qpAdm and qpGraph in R, with block jackknife.
use_zh: 在 R 中计算 f2、f3、f4、qpAdm 和 qpGraph，并做区组刀切。
note: Default alternative in AM13. Maier et al. 2023 eLife DOI verified.

name: Dsuite
ver_src: GitHub millanek/Dsuite; no tag or Bioconda package in this check (same as AM13)
use_en: Fast D, f4-ratio and f-branch statistics with block jackknife.
use_zh: 快速计算 D、f4 比值和 f-branch，并做区组刀切。
note: Version remains [待确认], as in AM13. The 2021 paper DOI was verified.

name: bcftools roh
ver_src: same bcftools 1.25 as section 1; also AM12
use_en: HMM runs of homozygosity. AM12 uses population allele frequencies after clone removal, not a default AF file.
use_zh: 用隐马尔可夫模型检测纯合片段。AM12 使用去克隆后按群体估计的等位基因频率，而不是默认频率文件。
note: Default ROH tool in AM12. ROH method paper: Narasimhan et al. 2016, 10.1093/bioinformatics/btw044. The samtools/bcftools suite DOI 10.1093/gigascience/giab008 still applies to the package.

name: hapROH
use_en: ROH from low-coverage data using a haplotype reference panel. Designed and tested on human data (1240k / 1000 Genomes panels). Not a clonal-history method: clonal propagation does not create ROH.
use_zh: 借助单倍型参考面板，从低覆盖度数据检测 ROH。按人类数据（1240k / 千人基因组面板）开发和测试。不能用来推断无性系历史：克隆繁殖不产生 ROH。
inp: pseudo-haploid or low-coverage genotypes, reference panel
note: Human-specific as distributed. Use on Vitis only after building a Vitis phased haplotype panel and validating on modern grapes downsampled to the target depth; unvalidated results must not be reported. ROH reflects inbreeding at the sexual origin of the sampled genotype, not centuries of clonal propagation. Prefer species-general ROHan, or bcftools roh when depth is sufficient. Newest is 0.70 on GitHub/PyPI; Bioconda lagged at 0.64.

name: Oliva et al. 2021 mapping benchmark
ver_src: Crossref-verified in the literature and methods reviews, 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Benchmark of 30 aDNA mapping strategies on simulated human reads: specific BWA-aln, BWA-mem and NovoAlign settings gave high precision and low reference bias, especially after MAPQ filtering; unbiased NovoAlign needed an IUPAC reference.
use_zh: 在模拟人类读段上比较了 30 种古DNA比对策略：特定参数下的 BWA-aln、BWA-mem 和 NovoAlign 都能达到高精度和低参考偏倚，MAPQ 过滤后更好；无偏的 NovoAlign 需要 IUPAC 参考基因组。

name: Schubert et al. 2012 bwa aln parameters
ver_src: already the DOI on the bwa aln row; restated as a source note
use_en: Source for disabling the seed with `-l 1024` on Illumina data. The Helicos command line is different. See the bwa aln note for what this paper did and did not show.
use_zh: Illumina 数据上用 `-l 1024` 关闭 seed 的出处。Helicos 的命令行不同。该文证明了什么、没证明什么，见 bwa aln 条目的备注。

name: Dolenz et al. 2024 reference bias
use_en: Assesses reference bias in ancient DNA datasets across mappers and MAPQ thresholds; test data include plant (maize) examples. Useful when mapping pips to PN40024.
use_zh: 评估不同比对器和 MAPQ 阈值造成的古DNA参考偏倚，测试数据包含植物（玉米）例子。把古籽比对到 PN40024 时可参考。
note: Title: Unravelling reference bias in ancient DNA datasets. Crossref issued 2024-07-01.

name: Günther and Nettelblad 2019 reference bias
ver_src: Crossref-verified in the literature review, 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Reference bias in low-coverage aDNA; relevant to mapping pips to PN40024.
use_zh: 低覆盖古DNA中的参考偏倚，与把古籽比对到 PN40024 有关。

name: Martiniano et al. 2020 graph mapping
ver_src: Crossref-verified in the literature review, 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Graph-genome mapping to reduce reference bias in aDNA.
use_zh: 用图基因组比对降低古DNA中的参考偏倚。

name: HOPS
ver_src: GitHub rhuebler/HOPS release 0.35, checked 2026-11-14 CST; Bioconda reported in the methods review
use_en: MALT plus MaltExtract for damage-aware screening of microbes. On grape pips it is for microbial or pathogen composition, not for authenticating endogenous grape DNA.
use_zh: MALT 加 MaltExtract，带损伤鉴定的微生物筛查。用于葡萄种子时，只做微生物和植物病原组成分析，不能用来鉴定葡萄内源 DNA 的真实性。

name: bamUtil trimBam
ver_src: GitHub statgen/bamUtil release v1.0.15, checked 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Trims N bases from each end of reads according to library type and UDG treatment, for example 2 nt each end after UDG-half, before pseudo-haploid calling.
use_zh: 按文库类型和 UDG 处理方式修剪读段两端 N 个碱基，例如 UDG-half 后每端修 2 nt，再做伪单倍型调用。
note: Method DOI [待确认]. This is the default terminal-trim tool named in the methods review.

name: Damage pattern by library type and UDG (idea)
use_en: Set the expected damage pattern before interpreting mapDamage plots: double-stranded libraries, C-to-T at 5-prime and G-to-A at 3-prime; single-stranded libraries, C-to-T at both ends; UDG-half, residual damage mostly in the last 1-2 terminal bases; full UDG removes most of that damage, but T from deamination of methylated plant cytosines (CG/CHG/CHH) remains.
use_zh: 判读损伤图之前，先按文库类型设定预期：双链文库是 5 端 C 到 T、3 端 G 到 A；单链文库两端都是 C 到 T；UDG-half 后损伤基本留在末端 1 到 2 个碱基；全 UDG 可去掉大部分这类损伤，但植物甲基化胞嘧啶（CG/CHG/CHH）脱氨生成的 T 去不掉。

name: Briggs et al. 2007 damage pattern
ver_src: Crossref-verified in the literature review, 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Defines the terminal C-to-T damage pattern used for authentication.
use_zh: 定义了用于鉴定的末端 C 到 T 损伤模式。

name: Sawyer et al. 2012 damage versus age
ver_src: Crossref-verified in the literature review, 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Damage and fragment length versus age; damage is not a simple clock.
use_zh: 损伤和片段长度与年代的关系；损伤不是简单的分子钟。

name: PMD-filter drift check (idea)
ver_src: uses PMDtools already in this catalogue
use_en: Compare PCA projections and f4 before and after PMDtools filtering. A clear shift suggests modern grape DNA contamination. This check is usable in plants; hapCon is not.
use_zh: 分别用 PMDtools 过滤后和全部读段做 PCA 投射和 f4。位置明显漂移，提示可能有现代葡萄 DNA 污染。这一检查可用于植物；hapCon 不能。

name: READv2
use_en: Relatedness from pairwise mismatch rates on pseudo-haploid low-coverage data (up to third degree). Developed on human data; calibrate on modern grape clone and relative pairs downsampled to the same depth. Noraz et al. 2026 (doi:10.1038/s41467-026-70166-z) recalibrated it for grape clones against VIVC, as confirmed against that paper in the 2026-11-14 literature re-review.
use_zh: 用伪单倍型低覆盖数据的两两错配率估计亲缘（可到三级）。按人类数据开发，用于葡萄时要用降到相同深度的现代克隆对和亲缘对校准。Noraz 等 2026（doi:10.1038/s41467-026-70166-z）曾用 VIVC 为葡萄克隆做过校准，已在 2026-11-14 的文献复审中对照该文确认。
note: This is the current READ lineage; the original READ paper (10.1371/journal.pone.0195491) is not a second tool entry.

name: KIN (KINgaroo)
ver_src: GitHub DivyaratanPopli/Kinship_Inference release v3.1.4, checked 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: HMM of IBD segments from low coverage (down to about 0.05x in the human tests), with optional contamination correction and an ROH model. Grape use needs calibration.
use_zh: 用隐马尔可夫模型从低覆盖数据识别 IBD 片段（人类测试中可到约 0.05 倍），可选污染校正和 ROH 模型。用于葡萄需要校准。

name: BREADR
use_en: Posterior probabilities of identical/twins, first-degree, second-degree or unrelated on ultra-low-coverage pseudo-haploid data. The identical class can be used for clone matching between ancient pips and living cultivars after calibration.
use_zh: 针对极低覆盖伪单倍型数据，给出 identical/twins、一级、二级或无关的后验概率。校准后，identical 类可用于古籽与现存品种的克隆匹配。

cluster: ROH and heterozygosity at low coverage (alternatives)
name: ROHan
ver_src: GitHub grenaud/ROHan release v1.0.7, checked 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Joint estimate of heterozygosity and ROH from a single BAM, with optional damage correction, and without a human haplotype panel. A species-general alternative to hapROH. The paper reports usable depth as low as 5−6x on modern samples and 7−8x on ancient samples with moderate DNA damage.
use_zh: 从单个 BAM 联合估计杂合度和 ROH，可做损伤校正，不依赖人类单倍型面板。可作为 hapROH 的物种通用替代。原文摘要给出的可用覆盖度为：现代样本低至 5−6 倍，有中等损伤的古代样本低至 7−8 倍。
note: ROH still reflects inbreeding at sexual origin, not clonal history.

name: Pre-registered allele-ratio test for seed-tissue mixture (idea)
use_en: If a high-depth ancient pip is available, pre-register a mixture test at sites that are heterozygous in at least one of the inferred genotypes. A seed-coat plus embryo mixture is two diploid genotypes with a maternal DNA fraction m (seed-coat contribution); expected minor-allele fractions vary continuously with m: for a maternal AA / embryo AB site the B fraction is about (1−m)/2; for a maternal AB / embryo AA site it is about m/2; sites heterozygous in both stay near 0.5. A single peak at 0.5 is consistent with one diploid genotype; extra components away from 0.5 are consistent with a mixture. A 1/3 (or 2/3) peak is only the special case of pure endosperm at sites such as maternal AA plus a paternal B (endosperm AAB). When endosperm DNA is also present, the seed is still a mix of maternal and paternal-derived haplotypes (the egg and the polar nuclei come from the same megaspore; the two sperm of one pollen grain share a genotype), but a single m is no longer the seed-coat fraction and a two-parameter, three-haplotype model is needed. Allele ratios alone cannot tell which component is maternal, and they cannot separate a tissue mixture from present-day contamination, because both are genotype mixtures. Triallelic sites are only an auxiliary indicator. To separate tissue mixing from modern contamination, the main evidence is (i) damage-stratified analysis: whether the minor genotype persists when only reads with terminal C-to-T substitutions are kept, and (ii) fragment-length distributions. A parent-offspring check is only supporting: it can rule out an unrelated modern contaminant, but it cannot rule out contamination from a related living cultivar, and the constraint itself must include selfing (the father is the same plant as the mother). Pre-registration thresholds remain [待确认] and must be locked before any ancient sample is analysed; this catalogue does not invent those numbers.
use_zh: 若有高深度古籽，预先登记一项混合检验：在至少一个推断基因型上为杂合的位点进行分析。种皮加胚的混合是两个二倍体基因型，母本（种皮）DNA 占比为 m；次要等位的预期比例随 m 连续变化：母本 AA、胚 AB 的位点，B 的比例约为 (1−m)/2；母本 AB、胚 AA 的位点，约为 m/2；二者都杂合的位点仍接近 0.5。单一的 0.5 峰与一个二倍体基因型相符；偏离 0.5 的额外分量与混合相符。1/3（或 2/3）峰只是纯胚乳的特例，例如母本 AA 加上父本贡献的 B（胚乳 AAB）。若同时有胚乳 DNA，这粒籽在单倍型上仍是母本与父本来源单倍型的混合（卵细胞和极核来自同一大孢子，同一花粉粒的两个精子基因型相同），但单个 m 不再等于种皮占比，需要两参数的三单倍型模型。单看等位比例既不能判断哪个成分是母本，也不能把组织混合与现代污染分开，因为二者都是基因型混合。三等位位点只作辅助指标。要把组织混合与现代污染分开，主要证据是：（i）按损伤分层，看只用带末端 C→T 的读段时次要基因型是否仍在；（ii）片段长度分布。亲子检验只是辅助：它可以排除无关的现代污染，但不能排除来自亲缘品种的污染；亲子约束本身必须包括自交（父本就是母本）。预注册阈值仍为 [待确认]，必须在分析任何古样本之前锁定；本目录不编造这些数字。
out: mixture-model fit, allele-ratio histogram, auxiliary triallelic count
note: Design note, with all numerical thresholds left [待确认] and not published here: restrict the primary analysis to transversion sites; compare a single-genotype model, an unconstrained mixture model, and a parent-offspring-constrained mixture model (the constraint must include selfing, in which the father is the same plant as the mother) using a likelihood-ratio test with a parametric bootstrap (a Bayesian version, if used, is only a sensitivity analysis). A second-tier decision on tissue mixture versus modern contamination should rest mainly on PMD- or damage-stratified reads and fragment-length distributions. A parent-offspring likelihood ratio can only rule out an unrelated source; related-cultivar modern contamination can still pass that test. Simulated negative controls (modern samples downsampled and given damage) and positive controls (in silico mixtures of parent-offspring pairs, a selfing scenario, endosperm scenarios, and both unrelated and related-cultivar contamination) should be completed, and the thresholds locked, before any ancient data are seen. Published grape pip studies reviewed here did not report this test. Li and Berger 2012 (10.1111/j.1469-8137.2012.04182.x) is a general review of endosperm development. The two-maternal, one-paternal endosperm genome ratio is stated here as the common angiosperm case [待确认]. Le et al. 2026 (10.1111/1755-0998.70210) mention seed-tissue ploidy only as background in rice and barley.

name: Sibling check among seeds from the same unit (idea)
use_en: Seeds from the same layer or even the same bunch may be full or half siblings. Check relatedness and then prune or model it before allele frequencies, PCA or f-statistics, as in the modern-sample workflow.
use_zh: 同一层位、甚至同一串果里的种子可能是全同胞或半同胞。在估计等位频率、做 PCA 或 f 统计之前，要先检查亲缘，再修剪或建模，逻辑与现代样本相同。
out: relatedness table and a pruned or modelled set

name: Process modern samples on the same footing (idea)
use_en: Before PCA projection or f-statistics, process modern samples on the same SNP set, with the same pseudo-haploidisation and the same transversion filter, and downsample to ancient depth when needed, so technical differences are not read as population differences.
use_zh: 做 PCA 投射或 f 统计之前，现代样本要用同一 SNP 集做伪单倍型化，做同样的颠换过滤，必要时降到古样本深度，避免把技术差异当成群体差异。

name: Separate seed death date from clone origin (idea)
use_en: A radiocarbon or tip date is the seed's death date. The clonal genotype may be older. Tip-dating is uninformative when the pip is the same clone as a living cultivar, because the molecular branch length is essentially zero.
use_zh: 碳十四或末端定年给出的是种子的死亡年代。克隆基因型可能更早就已存在。如果古籽与现存品种是同一克隆，分子分支长度近乎为零，末端定年没有信息量。
inp: AMS dates and, if used, molecular alignments
out: model settings that keep the two times distinct

name: Organelle-to-nuclear read ratio (idea)
use_en: Compare plastid and mitochondrial versus nuclear read ratios with a modern grape baseline as a secondary preservation or authenticity indicator. Nuclear plastid insertions (NUPT) can interfere; use competitive mapping.
use_zh: 把质体/线粒体与核读段的比例和现代葡萄基线比较，作为保存状况和真实性的辅助指标。核基因组里的质体插入（NUPT）会干扰，需要竞争性比对。

use_zh: 比较了标本馆材料中胚和叶片的 DNA；引言概括了种皮（2n，母本）、胚乳（3n）和胚（2n）的倍性。该研究材料是稻和野生大麦，不是葡萄，此处只引用这一组织遗传学背景。

name: Wales et al. 2014 archaeobotanical extraction
ver_src: Crossref-verified in the literature review, 2026-11-14 CST
use_en: Extraction tests on non-carbonised archaeobotanical remains, including grape seeds; used by Cohen et al. 2023. Bolognesi 2025 retells that an SDS / proteinase K / DTT plus phenol-chloroform protocol outperformed alternatives in that earlier work. The 2014 material was primarily desiccated and not charred, so results do not automatically transfer to charred pips.
use_zh: 在未炭化的植物考古残留（包括葡萄籽）上比较提取方法，Cohen 等 2023 曾使用。Bolognesi 2025 转述，该文中 SDS/蛋白酶 K/DTT 加酚氯仿的效果更好。2014 年的材料主要是干燥而非炭化的，不能直接外推到炭化籽。
